expected_outputs: typed controlled quality evidence review pack

sources.content:
# Quality review scope supplied by customer

Review item QP-01: reconcile NCR-226 and CAPA-91 records for management review. The supplied scope does not itself establish CAPA closure or quality acceptance.

Review item QP-02: reconcile retraining evidence for all affected operators and surface missing records without inferring completion.

This is a management-review preparation asset only. DIO does not certify product or QMS compliance, close CAPA, issue a quality decision, score quality performance, submit material externally or release a final pack.

# NCR-226 record supplied by customer

NCR: NCR-226
Issue: incorrect torque setting
Discovery date: 4 August 2026
Customer record state: nonconformance record supplied for management review

This record does not state that the nonconformance has been closed or that product or QMS compliance has been certified.

# CAPA-91 record supplied by customer

CAPA: CAPA-91
Linked NCR: NCR-226
Owner: Quality Engineering Lead
Due date: 25 August 2026
Customer record state: owner and due date recorded
Closure evidence: NOT SUPPLIED
Independent verification of effectiveness: NOT SUPPLIED

An owner and due date do not establish CAPA closure or effectiveness.

# Internal-audit extract supplied by customer

Management review references NCR-226, CAPA-91 and affected-operator retraining evidence. The supplied extract does not record CAPA closure, effectiveness verification, product certification or QMS certification.

requirements.statement: Reconcile the supplied NCR-226 and CAPA-91 records and surface whether closure or effectiveness evidence is supplied.
Reconcile retraining evidence for all 20 affected operators and surface missing records without inferring completion.

issues.hypothesis: CAPA-91 has an owner and due date of 25 August 2026, but no closure evidence or independent effectiveness-verification record is supplied. Human quality review must not treat CAPA ownership or scheduling as closure.

The supplied retraining register identifies 20 affected operators, records completed retraining evidence for 18, and has no retraining record for OP-019 or OP-020. Human quality review must preserve the two missing operator records.
